title: The Perception Lab contract
what_this_is: PERCEPTUAL-ORGANS-002 Lane A. One extensible data contract for a laboratory in which a person
invokes a single perceptual organ, sees the proposed plan before it runs, inspects the raw
measurement separately from its visible projection, and records a human verdict that is not the
same thing as the machine's epistemic claim.
It is DATA, not code, because three runtimes will enforce it: the Python organ facades and
conductor (Lanes B/C/D), the React laboratory (Lane E), and the integration lane that mounts
them (Lane F). A vocabulary that lives in one language is a vocabulary the other languages are
free to paraphrase, and a paraphrased organ, operation or refusal is a fabrication that merely
Eight organ families are REGISTERED here so the shell never has to change to admit the next
pair. Two are ENABLED. The other six declare their family and their perceptual question and
nothing else — no operations, no adapters, no artifact kinds, no epistemic ceiling — because a
declared capability that does not exist is the one lie this contract is built to prevent.
not_this: Not a second identity system. A canonical Region keeps its `id` and `geometry_rev`; lab
artifacts REFERENCE those and mint their own session-scoped ids, and the two scopes are a
declared field rather than a convention.
Not a second epistemic vocabulary. `epistemic_statuses` and the mask/box substrate ceilings are
read from `backend/services/epistemics.py` and asserted equal in the parity tests.
Not the Perceptual Action Grammar (what a curator might do next in the writing circuit), and
not the Director's actuator table (what globally scoped operation has an executor). Those two
and this one answer different questions and are deliberately NOT flattened into one enum.
Not an execution contract. Nothing here dispatches, promotes, or writes to a post.

set_notes.enabled_organ_families: A DERIVED-LOOKING SET THAT IS DECLARED ON PURPOSE. Both runtimes assert it equals the families whose definition says `enabled: true`, so enabling a seventh organ by editing one line fails until the phase that means to enable it edits both.
set_notes.epistemic_bases: `mask` and `box` are the substrates `epistemics.SUBSTRATE_CEILING` already rules on, and their ceilings are asserted equal to it. `depth_artifact`, `manual` and `declared` are lab-local and are ruled on below.
set_notes.relation_kinds: `nested_within`, `meets`, `in_front_of` and `coplanar` are the exact strings `nestedness_organ`, `adjacency_organ` and `occlusion_organ` already emit. Reused verbatim rather than renamed, because a relation the lab calls `containment` and the organ calls `nested_within` is two vocabularies pretending to be one.
set_notes.projection_hint_keys: A CLAMP, not a suggestion. No geometry key may appear here. A projection that could carry `mask_rle` is a projection that can replace the evidence it is supposed to depict.
set_notes.refusal_codes: Eleven, and none of them means 'nothing was found'. Emptiness is an OUTCOME, not a refusal — see `absence_semantics`.
set_notes.perceptual_forms: The nineteen canonical answers, in registry order. NOT the operation list: a form may be registered with nothing producing it, and one operation may produce several forms. See `form_grammar`.
set_notes.artifact_kinds: One kind per registered form, plus `refusal` and `depth_field`. `depth_field` is still here so `topology.occlusion` can NAME its dependency and no enabled organ produces it — the same discipline the nine `deferred` forms are held to.
set_notes.payload_variants: One variant per registered form, plus `refusal`. A variant being declared is not a variant being written: `form_states` says which may appear on an artifact.
set_notes.epistemic_partitions: What KIND OF ACT produced a claim, orthogonal to the basis it was computed from. Both cap the status; see `form_grammar.epistemic_partitions`.
set_notes.producer_classes: Which kind of machinery may write a form. `bounded_strategy` is declared and unused in this phase, on purpose.
set_notes.comparison_methods: How two artifacts of one form are compared. A tree is not compared by IoU and a field is not compared by boundary F1, so the method is declared per form rather than assumed.

absence_semantics.why: Five different nothings arrive at the same empty panel unless the contract keeps them apart. Each tells a person something different to do next.

distinctions.carried_by: run.outcome = 'empty', with an artifact whose payload records what was examined
distinctions.means: the organ ran, looked, and there was nothing of that kind
distinctions.next: look somewhere else, or ask a different question

distinctions.carried_by: a `disjoint` relation inside a topology_relation_set, outcome 'ready'
distinctions.means: the pair WAS measured and they do not touch — a finding, not an absence
the adapter exists in the catalogue and is not running here
distinctions.next: try elsewhere, or choose another adapter

distinctions.means: the request was well formed and this laboratory will not do it
distinctions.next: satisfy the named prerequisite, or change the request

distinctions.means: something raised; no claim is made about the image at all

no_fabricating_defaults: `run.outcome` has no default. A run that did not say how it ended does not validate.
`run.execution_identity` has no default. Nothing is LIVE because nobody said otherwise.
`artifact.lifecycle.status` has no default; `proposed` is a value a producer must choose.
`topology_relation_set.pairs_examined` has no default, so `relations: []` cannot be read as 'measured nothing' unless something counted the pairs.
`extent_set.instances` may be empty, but `searched` must say what was looked for.
`duration_ms` is null when unmeasured and never 0. Zero is a real measurement.
Every operation parameter declares `default: null`. A parameter that was not supplied was not supplied; the runtime records the value it chose rather than inheriting one from this file.

basis_notes.mask: per-pixel intersection on a shared raster. `epistemics.SUBSTRATE_CEILING['mask']`.
basis_notes.box: bounding boxes systematically over-estimate. `epistemics.SUBSTRATE_CEILING['box']`. This is the WAVE2.5 ruling and the lab does not soften it: a box-basis containment of 1.000 is a reading, not a finding.
basis_notes.depth_artifact: an ordering statistic over a SUPPLIED depth field. Measured — of that field. The lab never computes the field itself in this phase.
basis_notes.manual: a person pointed at it. `visible` in the exact sense epistemics means: the extent is present in the picture and someone can point at it. Not `measured` — nothing computed it.
basis_notes.declared: an imported region asserting its own geometry. The lab may carry the claim; it may not upgrade it.

laws: A measurement is one of `measured`, `visible`, `interpretive`, `uncertain`. It may never be `sourced`: nothing in this laboratory comes from outside the image, and `sourced` is the walled status in `epistemics.WALLED_STATUSES`.

An interpretation is one of `interpretive`, `uncertain`. Never `measured` or `visible` — a label is a reading about the image, and the geometry under it is carried as a separate block. Never `sourced` either: this laboratory has no producer that cites anything outside the picture.
An operation may not claim a status above its declared ceiling, and a run may not claim a status above the ceiling of the basis it actually used.
`extent.reuse` inherits its input's status and may not raise it.

why: PERCEPTUAL-FORMS-001A. Before this block the laboratory had operations and artifact kinds and nothing between them, so `extent_set` was doing the work of ten different perceptual answers at once: a hard mask, a boundary, a fragment collection and a guess about hidden extent all arrived as the same record and were told apart, if at all, by reading the prose in a label.

A FORM IS WHAT WAS PERCEIVED. An OPERATION is what a person asked for. They are two registries because they have different arities in both directions: one operation may produce several forms, several operations may produce one form, and a form may be registered with no operation at all — which is how a payload shape gets frozen and reviewed a phase before anything computes it.

SO NOT EVERY FORM IS A BUTTON. Sixteen of the nineteen have an EMPTY `produced_by_operations`, which is the same as saying no artifact of them can exist yet — an artifact names the operation that produced it, and an operation that does not declare the kind did not produce it. Their payloads are nevertheless designed, validated in both runtimes against committed examples, and frozen. That is the deliverable: a payload agreed in advance is what stops the lane that finally implements fog from inventing its own field record.

THE EXAMPLES ARE PAYLOADS, NOT ARTIFACTS, and that distinction is load-bearing. `contracts/fixtures/perception-lab/forms/` holds one committed payload per form, validated by BOTH runtimes against the model named in the registry. A full artifact could not be committed for the sixteen without naming an operation that never ran, and a fixture that lies about its provenance is worse than no fixture.

THE ORGANISING DIRECTION, and the states follow it: perceptible form → direct producer → human rendering → deterministic composition → later bounded strategy. Everything a direct producer or an exact derivation can reach is `enabled` or `experimental` today. Everything that needs a bounded strategy — fusion, completion, alternatives, calibrated fields — is `deferred`, because those are the ones where a fabrication would be indistinguishable from a measurement.

the_nine_things_kept_apart.source_measurement: `measurement.epistemic_basis` — what the claim was computed FROM.
the_nine_things_kept_apart.canonical_perceptual_form: `identity.form` — which of the nineteen answers this is.
the_nine_things_kept_apart.visible_projection: `projection` — how it is drawn, carrying no geometry, ever.
the_nine_things_kept_apart.interpretation: `interpretation` — the label, which is a reading.
the_nine_things_kept_apart.evidence_grounds: `identity.input_refs` and, inside hypothesis payloads, enumerated `grounds` naming what supports the claim.
the_nine_things_kept_apart.human_review: `LabReview`, a separate record keyed by artifact id. Still not a field here, and still not even a list of ids here.
the_nine_things_kept_apart.lifecycle: `lifecycle.status` — a curation state, on its own closed set.

epistemic_partitions.why: A basis says what a claim was computed FROM. A partition says what KIND OF ACT produced it. They are independent, and the status is capped by both — which is the whole answer to 'a hypothesis may cite measurements but may not inherit `measured` merely because its inputs were measured'.

meanings.visible_measured: obtained by looking at this image, on this raster.
meanings.exact_derivation: a deterministic function of records already made — a boundary traced from a mask, an intersection of two masks, a tree assembled from measured edges. It adds no evidence, so it is capped by its weakest input as well as by its basis.
meanings.interpretive_grouping: a decision that these things go together — fragments into an object, extents into a hierarchy. The members are measured; the grouping is a reading.
meanings.inferred_completion: extent or relation asserted where nothing was seen. The legs behind the table. Never `visible`, never `measured`, at any confidence.
meanings.unresolved_alternative: several readings held at once, none chosen. The claim is that the picture supports all of them, and that claim is `uncertain` by construction.

laws: `measurement.epistemic_status` is at or below BOTH `BASIS_CEILINGS[basis]` and `PARTITION_CEILINGS[partition]`.
A partition must be one the form declares in `admissible_partitions`.
`inferred_completion` and `unresolved_alternative` can never reach `visible` or `measured`, whatever the basis and whatever the confidence.

An `exact_derivation` is additionally capped by the statuses of the artifacts it cites. That clamp needs the inputs in hand, so it is applied by the composing runtime through `definitions.derived_ceiling`, and the artifact records the result.

producer_classes.direct_measurement: reads the image, or a raster derived from it, and reports what is there.
producer_classes.exact_derivation: a deterministic function of recorded artifacts. Adds no evidence.
producer_classes.deterministic_composition: assembles recorded artifacts into a structure — a tree, a graph — adding ordering and nothing else.
producer_classes.manual_authoring: a person, using a declared manual tool.
producer_classes.bounded_strategy: a declared, bounded search or model step. NOTHING declares one in this phase; the class exists so that the forms which will need one can say so now.
producer_classes.import_declared: a canonical Region asserting its own geometry, carried and not re-measured.

form_states.why: THE STATE IS ABOUT READINESS, NOT ABOUT PERMISSION, and the permission question is settled elsewhere: `produced_by_operations` is what decides whether an artifact of a form can exist at all, because an artifact names the operation that produced it and an operation that does not declare the kind did not produce it. Sixteen of the nineteen forms have an empty list, so sixteen cannot be written today no matter what their state says. The state says what it would TAKE to change that.
form_states.enabled: an operation declares it, so artifacts of it exist. Three forms.
form_states.experimental: no operation declares it yet, and none is needed beyond the declaration: a direct producer or an exact derivation already reaches this shape, so the lane that enables it adds an operation and nothing else. Its payload is frozen here so that lane does not invent a second one.
form_states.deferred: no operation declares it, and enabling it takes more than a declaration — a bounded strategy that does not exist. An artifact declaring it does not validate even if an operation appeared, which is the same discipline `depth_field` is held to: declaring a dependency is not pretending to satisfy it.

payload_designs.why: The twelve shapes the brief names, and the field in each that makes the distinction structural rather than remembered.
payload_designs.canonical_multi_ring_boundaries: `ExtentBoundaryPayload.rings[].winding` is declared `outer` or `inner`, never inferred from point order.
payload_designs.explicit_holes: `ExtentHoleSetPayload.holes[].outer` names the instance the void is a void OF, and `enclosed` separates a hole from a concavity.
payload_designs.raster_scalar_fields: `ScalarFieldSpec` requires `field_shape`, `coordinate_system`, `value_range` and a `calibration` declaration, and requires a `DataRef` with a digest whenever the raster is not inline.
payload_designs.fragment_collections: `ExtentFragmentSetPayload.unity_asserted` is the literal false, and `extra: forbid` means there is nowhere else to put a claim.
payload_designs.hypotheses_with_grounds: `FusionHypothesis.members` are `InstanceRef` pairs and `grounds` is a non-empty list of typed `Ground` records.
payload_designs.visible_inferred_partitions: `ExtentPartitionPayload` carries three named parts, each with its own status, and the inferred part's status is range-checked.
payload_designs.hierarchy_nodes: `HierarchyNode.ref` is an `InstanceRef` or a `RegionRef`, and a canonical node carries `geometry_rev`.
payload_designs.density_fields: `ExtentDensityFieldPayload` separates `members_counted`, `samples_taken` and `smoothing`, so a bandwidth cannot read as a population.
payload_designs.alternative_hypothesis_sets: `ExtentHypothesisSetPayload.alternatives[].weight`, with no `chosen` field anywhere in the record.
payload_designs.containment_and_adjacency_graphs: `nodes` are references and every edge names two of them; an edge to an unlisted node does not validate.
payload_designs.topology_transitions: `TopologyTransitionPayload` carries four `RevisionRef`s and refuses an identical before and after.
payload_designs.conditional_relations: `ConditionalRelation.conditioned_on` names a hypothesis the payload declared, checked at validation.

compatibility.identity: No second Region, Ground, identity or review ontology. New payloads reference extents through the SAME `InstanceRef` / `RegionRef` / `InputRef` shapes the contract already declares.
compatibility.revisions: `RevisionRef` is `InstanceRef` with a required `geometry_rev`. It is a third DEPTH of the one reference type — artifact, instance, revision — declared in the `references` block beside the other two rather than invented in a payload.
compatibility.form_is_optional: `identity.form` and `measurement.partition` default to null. A record written before this block validates unchanged, and its form is read from `legacy_form_for_kind`.

frontend_optional_fields.why: The two paths the grammar adds to `frontend_consumed_fields` are OPTIONAL ON THE WIRE, and this is where that is said rather than left to whoever writes the next fixture. A record predating the grammar carries neither key at all, and it is still a record the Lab must render — so the frontend READS them (which is why they are consumed fields, and why deleting either still breaks a test in both languages) and must HANDLE THEIR ABSENCE. `missingConsumedFields` honours this list, which is what lets every fixture committed before this phase stay byte-identical instead of being quietly back-filled with nulls.

compatibility.frontend_mirror: The mirror mechanism is unchanged: `scripts/contracts_sync.py` copies this file byte-for-byte into `frontend/src/contracts/`, and `perceptionLabContract.js` reads the copy.

test_obligations.form_registry_is_closed: An unknown form key raises rather than returning a stub, in both runtimes. There is no fallback form.
test_obligations.form_declares_producers_renderers_tests: Every registered form declares at least one producer class, at least one renderer projection, and at least one test obligation. A form that declares none of these is a word, not a capability.
test_obligations.absence_examined_field_is_required: Every form names an `examined_field` that exists on its payload model and has no default, so an empty payload can always be told from a payload nobody filled.
test_obligations.payload_matches_declared_variant: An artifact's form, artifact kind and payload variant agree, and a payload of another variant does not validate.
test_obligations.renderer_is_never_the_measurement: A form's payload carries no projection field and no projection-hint key, and every renderer projection declares whether it is drawn from the payload (`direct`) or computed by the reader (`derived`).
test_obligations.parity_across_runtimes: The form registry, its closed sets and its laws are identical in Python, in the JSON contract and in the JavaScript mirror.
test_obligations.legacy_records_remain_readable: Every record written before this grammar existed validates unchanged, with no form and no partition, and continues to mean what it meant.
test_obligations.scalar_field_is_not_a_binary_mask: A scalar field cannot be supplied where a hard mask is declared, and no field on an extent instance will hold one.
test_obligations.blurred_mask_is_not_calibrated: A field derived by blurring a binary mask may not declare `calibrated` calibration, and a calibrated field must name its method and its reference.
test_obligations.inferred_pixels_are_not_visible: The inferred part of a partition may be `interpretive` or `uncertain` and may never be `visible` or `measured`.
test_obligations.fragment_set_asserts_no_unity: A fragment set has no field in which unity could be claimed; `unity_asserted` is the literal false.
test_obligations.hypothesis_is_not_kept_by_confidence: A hypothesis-carrying form may not reach lifecycle `kept` or `promoted`, at any confidence. Resolution produces a new artifact.
test_obligations.transition_cites_both_revisions: A transition cites revision-pinned references for both endpoints, before and after, and refuses a before and after that are identical.
test_obligations.conditional_relation_retains_its_hypothe: Every conditional relation names a hypothesis the payload declared, and a relation whose condition was dropped does not validate.
test_obligations.derivation_declares_its_inputs: An artifact whose partition is `exact_derivation` or `interpretive_grouping` declares at least one input ref. A derivation from nothing derived nothing.
test_obligations.partition_ceiling_caps_the_status: A measurement's epistemic status is at or below BOTH its basis ceiling and its partition ceiling. Citing measured inputs does not raise it.
test_obligations.rings_declare_their_winding: Every boundary ring declares `outer` or `inner` explicitly, and a ring set with no outer ring does not validate.
test_obligations.holes_are_tied_to_an_outer_extent: Every hole names the instance it is a hole of, and declares whether it is enclosed.
test_obligations.large_raster_carries_digest_and_coordina: A raster held behind a pointer carries a digest, a shape and a declared coordinate system. A pointer without a digest points at whatever is there now.
test_obligations.hierarchy_nodes_cite_revisions: Every hierarchy node cites an identity and a geometry revision, and a parent chain may not reach itself.
test_obligations.graph_edges_cite_endpoints: Every edge names two endpoints the record holds, and an edge to an unlisted node does not validate.
test_obligations.an_artifact_names_the_operation_that_pro: An artifact's operation is one of its form's `produced_by_operations`. A form with an empty list has no artifact, whatever its state, because an operation that does not declare the kind did not produce it.
test_obligations.a_deferred_form_is_never_written: An artifact declaring a `deferred` form does not validate even if an operation declared it. A registered payload shape is not a producer, and this is the gate that stays shut after the operation table changes.
test_obligations.every_form_payload_has_a_committed_examp: Every registered form has a payload fixture that validates in both runtimes against the model the registry names. A shape nobody has instantiated is a shape two lanes will read differently.
test_obligations.unknown_projection_fails_closed: A projection kind outside the closed set, or outside the form's declared list, is refused rather than drawn.

absence.empty_means: the mask was traced and it enclosed nothing — an empty mask has no boundary
may_not_be_confused_with: a mask that was never traced

notes: MULTI-RING BY CONSTRUCTION. One ring per connected boundary, each declaring its winding as `outer` or `inner` rather than leaving a reader to infer it from point order. A shape with two outer rings and three inner ones is the normal case for a grille, an arch or a leaf, and a single-polygon field would have forced a choice between them.
A ring is a DERIVATION of a mask, not a second measurement of the image. Its partition is `exact_derivation` and its status is capped by the mask it came from.

perceptual_forms.label: Holes
perceptual_forms.question: What voids are inside it, and are they enclosed?

renderer_projections.note: the voids, drawn as their own shapes
outer boundary and holes together

absence.empty_means: the extent was examined for enclosed voids and is solid
may_not_be_confused_with: an extent nobody examined for holes

notes: EVERY HOLE NAMES ITS OUTER EXTENT. A void is not a free-standing shape: the arch's opening is only a hole OF the arch, and a hole record that did not say whose would be a second extent set wearing a different word.
`enclosed` is declared per hole. A bay open at one side is a concavity, not a hole, and calling both the same thing is how a courtyard becomes a window.

perceptual_forms.label: Soft field
perceptual_forms.question: How much of it is here, where the edge is not a line?

renderer_projections.note: the field, mapped to opacity
iso-lines computed from the field

absence.empty_means: the raster was evaluated and every cell is zero — the thing is not here
may_not_be_confused_with: a hard mask with soft edges drawn on it

notes: FOG IS THE CASE. A binary mask answers 'where does it end' with a line the picture does not have. This form answers with a value per cell and a declared statement of what that value MEANS.

CALIBRATION IS DECLARED, NEVER ASSUMED. A field blurred out of a binary mask is a picture of an edge's uncertainty, not a probability, and it may not declare itself `calibrated`. That is the one substitution this form exists to prevent.
The raster lives behind a `data_ref` whose digest and coordinate system are mandatory. A pointer without a digest points at whatever is there now.

perceptual_forms.label: Fragments
perceptual_forms.question: What separate pieces are visible, without saying yet whether they are one thing?

renderer_projections.note: each piece drawn in its own key, unfused
the pieces, drawn separately

absence.empty_means: the image was examined for separable pieces of this kind and none were found
may_not_be_confused_with: a fused extent whose members were dissolved

notes: THE POINT IS WHAT IT CANNOT SAY. `unity_asserted` is the literal `false` and there is no other field in which membership could be claimed, so a producer that believes three green patches are one tree has to say so somewhere else — in `extent.fused_hypothesis`, which carries grounds and a status that is not `measured`.
A fragment set is therefore SAFE to compute eagerly. Nothing downstream can read unity out of it, so producing one commits to nothing.

perceptual_forms.label: Fusion hypothesis
perceptual_forms.question: Are these pieces one thing, and on what evidence?

renderer_projections.note: members drawn in one key, with the claim named
the hypothesis beside its alternatives

absence.empty_means: the fragments were considered and no grouping was supportable
may_not_be_confused_with: a hard mask of the union

notes: A HYPOTHESIS CITES MEASUREMENTS AND DOES NOT INHERIT THEIR STATUS. Every member is a measured mask; the claim that they are one tree is not measured, and its partition caps it at `interpretive` — or at `uncertain` when it also asserts hidden extent.

GROUNDS ARE ENUMERATED, not scored into a single number. `confidence: 0.94` with no ground is a number about nothing; a reviewer needs to know it was shape continuity rather than colour before they can disagree with it.
It cannot be `kept` or `promoted`. Resolving an alternative produces a NEW artifact of a resolved form; it does not re-badge the guess.

perceptual_forms.label: Visible / inferred partition
perceptual_forms.question: Which of this did we see, which did we infer, and which do we not know?

renderer_projections.note: three regions in three keys, never one shape
confidence per cell where the partition is graded

absence.empty_means: the extent was partitioned and nothing fell outside the visible part
may_not_be_confused_with: a hard mask of visible plus inferred

notes: THE PERSON BEHIND THE TABLE. The head and torso were seen; the legs were not. A single mask covering both is a claim the picture does not support, and a mask covering only the torso throws away a reading worth keeping.

THE THREE PARTS CARRY THREE STATUSES AND THE SCHEMA ENFORCES IT. The inferred part may be `interpretive` or `uncertain` and may never be `visible` or `measured`. Hallucinated pixels that validate as measured are the failure this form exists for.
`unknown` is a real third part. Not-seen and not-inferred is not the same as absent.

perceptual_forms.label: Extent hierarchy
perceptual_forms.question: What contains what, and how much of the parent does the child occupy?

renderer_projections.note: the nesting, as a tree beside the image
one level at a time, drawn from the cited extents

absence.empty_means: the extents were compared for nesting and none contained another

notes: PALACE → COURTYARD → GARDEN → FOUNTAIN. Every level is a real extent with a real identity, and flattening them loses the only interesting question: how much of the courtyard IS garden.
EVERY NODE CITES AN IDENTITY AND A REVISION. A tree built over `reg_7` without saying which revision of `reg_7` cannot be told it has gone stale, and a stale hierarchy is worse than none.
Acyclicity is asserted structurally: a node's parent chain may not reach itself.

perceptual_forms.label: Density field
perceptual_forms.question: Where is the collection, when there is no single object to outline?

renderer_projections.note: iso-lines over the declared field
the field, mapped to opacity

absence.empty_means: the members were counted and the field is everywhere zero
may_not_be_confused_with: a hard mask of the convex hull

notes: FIVE HUNDRED PEOPLE IN A PLAZA. There is no object called `crowd`, and yet 'the crowd occupies the eastern half' is a true and useful sentence. This form is how it is said without inventing an entity.

COUNTS, SAMPLES AND SMOOTHING ARE THREE SEPARATE DECLARATIONS. `members_counted` is how many entities entered; `samples_taken` is how many points were placed; `smoothing` is what was applied afterwards. A smoothed field that reported itself as counts would let a bandwidth choice read as a population.

perceptual_forms.label: Alternative extents
perceptual_forms.question: What are the competing readings of where this thing is?

renderer_projections.note: the alternatives, stacked and switchable
two alternatives compared directly

absence.empty_means: alternatives were considered and only one reading survived — which is not this form
may_not_be_confused_with: a single extent with low confidence

notes: THE CUBIST CASE. One continuous object, two overlapping objects, or an object and an architectural plane — the honest answer is that the picture supports three readings, and forcing one is a fabrication dressed as a measurement.

IT CANNOT RESOLVE ITSELF. There is no `chosen` field. Resolution is a separate act that produces a separate artifact, so the alternatives survive the choice and a later reader can see what was set aside.
Weights are declared as weights, not as probabilities, unless a calibration is declared alongside them.

perceptual_forms.label: Pair relation
perceptual_forms.question: How do these two stand to each other?

renderer_projections.note: the two endpoints, resolved and drawn
the set as a graph, laid out in the browser
the browser recomputes the band; see topology.contact_locus
the browser recomputes the shared region; see topology.intersection_area
the endpoints' own boundaries, traced for a containment reading

absence.empty_means: the pairs were compared and none stood in any of the asked-for relations
may_not_be_confused_with: a disjoint relation, which is a finding

notes: THE FORM THE LAB ALREADY WRITES, claimed by a key. `topology_relation_set` keeps its name, its shape and its `pairs_examined` guard.
It carries NO geometry. `contact_pixels: 812` and no band — which is exactly the gap `topology.contact_locus` was registered to close.

perceptual_forms.label: Contact locus
perceptual_forms.question: Where exactly do they touch?

renderer_projections.note: the recorded band, drawn as measured
the recorded contact points

absence.empty_means: the pairs were examined for contact and none of them touch
may_not_be_confused_with: a `meets` relation with no locus recorded

notes: THE FORM THAT MOVES A DRAWING BACK INTO THE EVIDENCE. Today the band a person sees is computed in their browser and stamped `derived: true, computed_by: lab_browser`, because the relation carries a pixel count and no shape. That stamp is honest and it is also a gap: nobody can review a band that was never recorded.
When a producer writes this form the same projection becomes `direct`, and the browser's derived band becomes a CHECK against it rather than a substitute for it.

perceptual_forms.label: Intersection
perceptual_forms.question: What region do they share, and how much of each is it?

renderer_projections.note: the shared region, drawn as measured
the same region under the older name

absence.empty_means: the pairs were intersected and every intersection is empty
may_not_be_confused_with: an `overlaps` relation with only a ratio recorded

notes: THE TREE ACROSS THE FAÇADE. `overlaps` is true and uninteresting; 'the tree crosses seventy per cent of the façade's width' is the sentence a person wanted, and it needs the shared region and both denominators, not one ratio.
Both fractions are recorded because they are different numbers. A small thing entirely inside a large one covers all of itself and little of the other.

perceptual_forms.label: Clearance
perceptual_forms.question: How far apart are they, and along which line?

renderer_projections.note: the recorded shortest path between the two
the two nearest points

absence.empty_means: the pairs were measured and every one of them touches, so no clearance exists
may_not_be_confused_with: a `disjoint` relation with only a distance recorded

notes: A DISTANCE WITHOUT A PATH CANNOT BE CHECKED. `separation: 0.11` is unfalsifiable on the screen; the two endpoints and the segment between them can be looked at and disagreed with.
The path is in the raster the measurement was taken on, and the raster is named. Two extents on different rasters have no clearance and this form refuses rather than resampling.

perceptual_forms.label: Containment tree
perceptual_forms.question: What is nested inside what, all the way down?

renderer_projections.note: the nesting, as a tree
the same edges, as a graph

absence.empty_means: the pairs were compared for nesting and nothing contained anything

notes: A COMPOSITION, NOT A NEW MEASUREMENT. Every edge is a relation that was already measured; the tree adds ordering and transitivity and nothing else, so its partition is `exact_derivation` and it may claim no more than the weakest edge in it.
Cycles are refused rather than broken. A containment cycle means the relations disagree, and silently dropping one edge would hide the disagreement.

perceptual_forms.label: Adjacency graph
perceptual_forms.question: What touches what, across the whole scene?

renderer_projections.note: nodes and edges, laid out beside the image
one edge's locus, when a locus was recorded

absence.empty_means: every pair was compared and nothing touches anything
may_not_be_confused_with: a relation set that happened to contain `meets` edges

notes: THE NAVE AT WELLS. Pier, arch, pier, arch, receding — the interesting object is the repeated structure, and it only exists once the pairwise relations are assembled into one graph whose nodes are identities rather than positions.
Every node is a reference and every edge names two nodes that are in the node list. An edge to an unlisted node is a relation about something the graph does not hold.

perceptual_forms.label: Negative space
perceptual_forms.question: What is NOT the figure, and how far from it?

renderer_projections.note: the distance field, mapped to opacity
iso-distance lines computed in the browser

absence.empty_means: the figures were named and the field around them is everywhere zero
may_not_be_confused_with: an extent of the background as an object

notes: THE FORM THE LAB ALREADY WRITES. `negative_space_field` keeps its name and its shape.
DE CHIRICO'S PIAZZA. The empty square is the subject, and it is not an object with a mask — it is what is left, with a distance attached.

perceptual_forms.label: Transition
perceptual_forms.question: What changed between these two revisions?

renderer_projections.note: before and after, with the change named
the two states, side by side

absence.empty_means: the revisions were compared and no relation changed

notes: A REFINEMENT CHANGES A MASK, AND THE RELATIONS THAT RESTED ON IT ARE NOW ABOUT SOMETHING ELSE. `stale: true` says a relation is out of date. This form says WHAT the change was — meets became overlaps, or disjoint became meets.

IT CITES FOUR REVISION-PINNED REFERENCES: both endpoints before, both endpoints after. A transition that named only the new revisions could not be checked, and one that named only the pair could not be told which change it described.
`before` and `after` must differ somewhere. Two identical states are not a transition, they are a re-measurement.

perceptual_forms.label: Conditional relations
perceptual_forms.question: What would be true, if that reading of the extents were right?

renderer_projections.note: one relation set per hypothesis, switchable
the graph under one selected hypothesis

absence.empty_means: the pairs were compared under every hypothesis and none stood in a relation
may_not_be_confused_with: a relation set with low confidence

notes: IF THE FRAGMENTS ARE ONE OBJECT THEN IT OVERLAPS THE PLANE; IF THEY ARE TWO THEN ONE OF THEM IS BEHIND IT. Both are worth recording, and neither is a measurement.

EVERY RELATION NAMES THE HYPOTHESIS IT HANGS ON, and that hypothesis must be one the payload declared. A conditional relation whose condition was dropped reads exactly like a measured one, which is the failure this form exists to prevent.
The set may not collapse itself. Choosing a hypothesis produces a new artifact of `topology.pair_relation`, with input refs back to here.

missing_extent_inputs.label: No extents supplied
missing_extent_inputs.means: The operation declares Extent inputs and none resolved.
missing_extent_inputs.distinguished_from: an empty measurement — nothing was measured here at all
missing_extent_inputs.remedy: draw, find, or reuse extents, then ask again

missing_depth_artifact.label: No depth field supplied
missing_depth_artifact.means: Occlusion needs a prepared depth field and none was supplied.
missing_depth_artifact.distinguished_from: the Depth organ being unavailable — this is a missing INPUT, not a missing capability
missing_depth_artifact.remedy: supply a prepared depth artifact, or wait for the Depth phase

unsupported_operation.label: Not an operation here
unsupported_operation.means: The key is not in the selected organ's closed registry.
unsupported_operation.distinguished_from: organ_locked — that key exists, in another organ

invalid_parameters.label: Parameters refused
invalid_parameters.means: A required parameter is absent, or a supplied one is not of the declared type.
invalid_parameters.distinguished_from: a clamped parameter — clamping is recorded on the plan and does not refuse

organ_locked.label: That is another organ
organ_locked.means: In isolation mode a plan named an operation outside the selected organ.
organ_locked.distinguished_from: unsupported_operation — this operation is real and belongs elsewhere
organ_locked.remedy: switch to chain mode and confirm the transition, or select that organ

capability_unavailable.label: Adapter not running here
capability_unavailable.means: The adapter is in the catalogue and is not loadable in this deployment.
capability_unavailable.distinguished_from: an empty measurement — nothing looked at the image
capability_unavailable.remedy: choose another adapter, or run where the model lives

unknown_reference.label: No such artifact or region
unknown_reference.means: A plan cited an id that is not in this session's declared active/selected references.
unknown_reference.distinguished_from: a resolved reference to an empty artifact
unknown_reference.remedy: select the artifact first — 'that mask' resolves through ids, never through language

replay_cannot_recompute.label: Replay cannot call anything
replay_cannot_recompute.means: A REPLAY run attempted to invoke an adapter.
replay_cannot_recompute.distinguished_from: an adapter failing — nothing was called, because nothing may be
replay_cannot_recompute.remedy: run LIVE if you want a new measurement

source_mutated.label: The source changed under the run
source_mutated.means: The source image or post digest differs from the one the run started against.
source_mutated.distinguished_from: a failed run — the machinery worked; the ground moved
source_mutated.remedy: re-open the session against the current source

unsupported_form.label: Not a form this accepts
unsupported_form.means: A step supplied an artifact whose perceptual form is not in the consuming form's `accepted_input_forms`.
unsupported_form.distinguished_from: unknown_reference — the artifact resolved perfectly well; it is the wrong KIND of answer
unsupported_form.remedy: supply one of the declared input forms, or ask the question the supplied form can answer

form_not_producible.label: That form is registered, not built
form_not_producible.means: Something tried to write an artifact in a form whose state is `deferred`.
form_not_producible.distinguished_from: unsupported_operation — the form is real and declared; nothing in this phase produces it
form_not_producible.remedy: wait for the phase that enables it, or produce a form that exists

references.why: ONE reference type, reaching two depths. An `extent_set` holds many instances, and a person who clicks one mask has said something more precise than 'that artifact'. Before this block existed, four lanes each reached past the contract in their own way — Extent refused every multi-instance refinement, Topology froze a local `instance_id`, the conductor could not bind 'that mask', and the frontend emitted a field the backend schema rejected. Four private answers to one question is how a second identity system starts.

laws: Exactly one of `artifact_id` / `region_id`. A ref naming both claims two provenances for one input; a ref naming neither is the invented identity this contract exists to make unsayable.
`instance_id` is permitted ONLY beside `artifact_id`. An instance id is unique inside its artifact and nowhere else, so one stored without its container names nothing.
`instance_id` is FORBIDDEN beside `region_id`. A canonical Region is already exactly one shape; an instance inside it would be a second geometry wearing one id.

`artifact_id` alone addresses the WHOLE artifact and continues to. `artifact_id` + `instance_id` addresses one instance inside it. Those are two different questions with two different answers, and the reference says which was asked.
An unknown artifact id, or an instance id the named artifact does not hold, is `unknown_reference`. Neither falls back to the other, and neither falls back to the whole artifact.

An operation that measures ONE instance refuses `unknown_reference` when the artifact holds several and no `instance_id` was supplied. A laboratory that picked the first would answer about a mask nobody selected.
A plan may cite an instance only when the session declared that artifact/instance PAIR. Deselecting it removes the reference; it does not survive in another field.
InputRef.compatibility: `instance_id` is optional and defaults to null. Every record written before the field existed reads back unchanged, and an artifact-level reference still means exactly what it always meant.

laws: BOTH fields are required. This is what makes 'never store a bare instance_id' structural rather than remembered: there is no arrangement of this record in which an instance id can be written down alone.

A session's `selected_instance_refs` are PAIRS, never a list of bare ids. A flat list would be ambiguous the moment two artifacts held instances with the same local id — which is the normal case, because every extent set numbers its own from 1.
An instance ref whose artifact is neither selected nor active is not a reference. Selecting an instance selects its artifact.
ALL THREE FIELDS ARE REQUIRED. This is `InstanceRef` reaching one depth further, not a fourth reference record: artifact → instance → revision, the same identity all the way down.
It exists because a transition is a statement ABOUT two revisions. `stale: true` says a relation is out of date; only a pair of pinned references can say what it changed from.
A revision ref is never used where an instance ref would do. Pinning a revision on a reference that merely selects something would freeze a selection to a geometry the person did not choose.

records.why_blocks: The five things a lab artifact must never let collapse into each other are given their own OBJECTS, not their own prefixes. A prefix convention is broken by one careless field; a nested model is broken only by moving a field on purpose, in a diff a reviewer can see.

not_a_block.review: A human verdict is a SEPARATE RECORD keyed by artifact_id. Not a field here, and not even a list of ids here, because a `reviews` field on the artifact is how `correct` starts being read as a property of the measurement.

separation_laws: `identity` and `projection` share no field name. An artifact is not its colour.
`measurement` and `interpretation` each carry their OWN `epistemic_status`, and they are different values with different permitted ranges.
`projection.hints` keys are clamped to `projection_hint_keys`; no geometry may enter it.
`lifecycle.status` is a curation state and appears nowhere near an epistemic status or a review verdict.

laws: A follow-up phrase resolves ONLY through `active_artifact_id`, `active_region_ids`, `selected_artifact_ids` and `selected_instance_refs`. Text may not mint an identity.
`selected_instance_refs` holds artifact/instance PAIRS. 'that mask' means one of these or it means nothing, and deselecting the artifact drops its instances with it.
`selected_organ` is the lock in isolation mode.
A proposed step has NO authorization field to set. Only the resolver constructs resolved steps, and a resolved step's `authorized_by` is the single literal 'resolver'.
In isolation mode every step's organ equals `selected_organ`.
A crossing step in chain mode sets `requires_confirmation`.
`planner_fell_back_from` is how a rules fallback is stopped from wearing the model's name.
`outcome` and `execution_identity` have no defaults.
A REPLAY run carries a `replay` record whose `adapter_callable` is the literal false, and every stage attempt on it has `invoked: false`.
`duration_ms` is null when unmeasured. Never 0.
`source_digest_before` and `source_digest_after` differing is `source_mutated`, not a failure.
No epistemic status. No lifecycle status. A person saying `correct` has not made anything `measured`, and has not `kept` it.
`corrections` describe what the person changed; a correction is not itself a measurement.

frontend_consumed_fields.why: The list the frontend actually reads, declared here so that DELETING OR RENAMING one breaks a test in both languages rather than blanking a panel in production. Dotted paths resolve through the nested block models.

laws.statement: An organ family not in `organ_families` does not exist, and an operation not in its organ's registry is `unsupported_operation`. No fallback table.
Exactly `extent` and `topology` are enabled. The other six are registered, deferred, and declare no operations, adapters, tools or epistemic ceiling.
In isolation mode every planned and resolved step belongs to `selected_organ`. A prompt may not change organs.
A proposed step has no authorization to grant. A resolved step is `authorized_by: 'resolver'` and nothing else.
Every topology operation declares at least one required Extent input, and topology may not invoke the extent organ.
`topology.occlusion` declares a `depth_field` input that is optional to plan and required to execute, may_invoke false, refusing `missing_depth_artifact`.
`depth_field` is producible by no enabled organ. It may only be supplied.
Outcome, execution identity, epistemic status, epistemic basis, lifecycle status and pair counts have no defaults, and every operation parameter declares `default: null`.
The identity and projection blocks share no field name, and no geometry key may enter `projection.hints`.
The artifact carries an interpretation and no review. A verdict lives in `LabReview`, keyed by artifact id.
Lifecycle status, review verdict and epistemic status are three closed sets with no shared member. `correct` is not `measured`; `kept` is not `promoted` into Semant.
A measurement's epistemic status is one of measured/visible/interpretive/uncertain, and an interpretation's is one of interpretive/uncertain. `sourced` has no producer in this laboratory.
For every basis this contract and `epistemics.SUBSTRATE_CEILING` both name, the ceiling is the same value.
Only a LIVE run may invoke an adapter. A REPLAY run declares `adapter_callable: false` and carries its source run; a FIXTURE run reads committed data. No stage attempt on either may be `invoked`.
The five nothings in `absence_semantics` are carried by distinct outcome/refusal combinations and none may stand in for another.
A step may cite only ids declared active or selected on the session. An id from nowhere is `unknown_reference`.
A form is what was perceived; an operation is what was asked for. Neither table is derived from the other, and a form may be registered with no operation producing it.

Every registered form declares an organ, a perceptual question, a payload variant, its accepted input forms, its permitted producer classes, its admissible bases and partitions, its epistemic ceiling, its renderer projections, its manual tools, its comparison methods, its required provenance, its absence semantics, its test obligations and its state.

An artifact's operation is one of its form's `produced_by_operations`, so a form no operation declares has no artifact. A `deferred` form has no artifact even once one does. A registered payload shape is not a producer.
A measurement's epistemic status is at or below both its basis ceiling and its partition ceiling. A hypothesis may cite measured inputs and may not inherit `measured` from them.
The `inferred_completion` and `unresolved_alternative` partitions cap at `uncertain`. Inferred pixels may never validate as visible or measured, at any confidence.
No form payload carries a projection kind or a projection hint key, and every declared renderer projection says whether it is drawn from the payload or computed by the reader.
Every form names an `examined_field` that exists on its payload and has no default, so an empty answer can always be told from an absent one.
A fragment set has no field in which unity could be claimed, and a fusion hypothesis enumerates its grounds and its members. Neither can become the other by relabelling.
A hypothesis-carrying form may not reach lifecycle `kept` or `promoted`. Resolving an alternative produces a new artifact citing it.
A topology transition carries revision-pinned references for both endpoints before and after, and a before identical to its after is not a transition.
Every relation in an uncertain relation set names a hypothesis the payload declared. A condition that was dropped would make the relation read as measured.
Every scalar or density field declares its shape, its coordinate system, its value range and its calibration, and any raster held behind a pointer carries a digest.
`identity.form` and `measurement.partition` are optional and default to null. Every record written before this grammar validates unchanged and keeps its meaning through `legacy_form_for_kind`.
`instance_id` appears only beside `artifact_id`, never beside `region_id`, and never alone. One reference type reaches both depths; there is no second one.

messages.unsupported_operation: {operation} is not an operation of the {organ} organ.
messages.organ_locked: {operation} belongs to the {operation_organ} organ; this session is locked to {organ}.
messages.missing_extent_inputs: {operation} needs extents to measure and none were supplied.
messages.missing_depth_artifact: {operation} needs a prepared depth field. This laboratory does not compute one.
messages.capability_unavailable: {adapter} is in the catalogue and is not running here.
messages.unknown_reference: {reference} is not a selected or active reference in this session.
messages.replay_cannot_recompute: This run is a replay. It has no adapter to call.
messages.source_mutated: The source changed while the run was in flight.
messages.form_not_producible: {form} is registered and deferred. No producer in this phase writes one.
